permanent.name: Shadowform
permanent.description: Capstone. You take on Shadowform for the whole run, and when an enemy dies with Shadow Word: Pain on it, it bursts for {v}% of its maximum health on everything within 6 yd and the pain jumps to the enemy nearest it.
permanent.rendered_rank1: Capstone. You take on Shadowform for the whole run, and when an enemy dies with Shadow Word: Pain on it, it bursts for 4% of its maximum health on everything within 6 yd and the pain jumps to the enemy nearest it.

permanent.name: Dire Bear Form
permanent.description: Capstone. You fight in Dire Bear Form: 25% more maximum health and 10% less damage taken. A free Swipe tears around you every 3 sec, and every enemy Swipe hits heals you for 0.3% of your maximum health. You start every run with Shred instead of Wrath. You can't also learn Cat Form.

permanent.name: Cat Form
permanent.description: Capstone. You fight in Cat Form: 10% more damage, 10% more critical strike chance and 15% faster movement, and Shred's cooldown is 20% shorter. You start every run with Shred instead of Wrath. You can't also learn Dire Bear Form.
